metadata.title: A new localization approach for Willmore flows: Asymptotic analysis for the Dirichlet problem
metadata.abstract: We study the Willmore flow with Dirichlet boundary conditions by means of a new geometric localization approach. In contrast to previous works, we do not rely on localized energy estimates, but on uniformly controlled isothermal coordinates and localized parabolic a priori estimates. For genus-zero surfaces satisfying an explicit energy condition depending only on the prescribed boundary data, we prove global existence together with a dichotomy between smooth convergence and subconvergence to a complete noncompact Willmore surface. If the initial Willmore energy is at most $4\pi$, this dichotomy reduces to smooth convergence after reparametrization, and we show that this additional threshold is optimal. As an application, we obtain an existence criterion for the stationary Dirichlet Willmore problem.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 通过一致受控的等温坐标与局部抛物先验估计研究 Dirichlet Willmore 流，在亏格零及边界数据相关能量条件下证明全局存在和两种长期极限；能量≤4π 时得到光滑收敛。
analysis.breakthrough: 以新的几何局部化替代既有局部能量估计路径，并证明额外4π阈值最优。
analysis.limitations: 全局存在仍需边界相关能量条件；一般二分法中的子收敛不等于全序列光滑收敛。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何流的核心分析方法与锐阈值结果。
